```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(data.table)
library(table1)
library(ggplot2)
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)

DATA_DIR <- "data/"
```

# Load Data

```{r load-data}
demographics_dt <- fread(paste0(DATA_DIR, "demographics.csv"))
icd_feats_dt <- fread(paste0(DATA_DIR, "icd_features.csv"))
labs_dt <- fread(paste0(DATA_DIR, "lab_results.csv"))
meds_dt <- fread(paste0(DATA_DIR, "meds.csv"))
docvecs_dt <- fread(paste0(DATA_DIR, "embedded_BioClinicalBERT.csv"))
prior_sxs_dt <- fread(paste0(DATA_DIR, "findings_previous.csv"))
index_sxs_dt <- fread(paste0(DATA_DIR, "findings_index.csv"))
utilization_dt <- fread(paste0(DATA_DIR, "utilization.csv"))
prior_vitals_dt <- fread(paste0(DATA_DIR, "prior_vitals.csv"))
index_vitals_dt <- fread(paste0(DATA_DIR, "current_visit_vitals.csv"))
```

# Clean Up Column Names
```{r clean-colnames}
#Helper Function to Add Prefix
clean_up_cols <- function(colm, prefix) {return(ifelse(colm == 'pat_enc_csn_id', 'pat_enc_csn_id', paste0(prefix, colm)))}

setnames(icd_feats_dt, c('pat_enc_csn_id', sapply(names(icd_feats_dt)[-1], \(dxname) paste0('prior_dx_', dxname))))
setnames(labs_dt, names(labs_dt), sapply(names(labs_dt), \(x) clean_up_cols(x,'lab_')))
setnames(meds_dt, names(meds_dt), sapply(names(meds_dt), \(x) clean_up_cols(x,'med_')))
setnames(prior_sxs_dt, names(prior_sxs_dt), sapply(names(prior_sxs_dt), \(x) clean_up_cols(x,'prior_sxs_')))
setnames(index_sxs_dt, names(index_sxs_dt), sapply(names(index_sxs_dt), \(x) clean_up_cols(x,'index_sxs_')))
setnames(utilization_dt, names(utilization_dt), sapply(names(utilization_dt), \(x) clean_up_cols(x,'util_')))
setnames(prior_vitals_dt, names(prior_vitals_dt), sapply(names(prior_vitals_dt), \(x) clean_up_cols(x,'prior_vitals_')))
setnames(index_vitals_dt, names(index_vitals_dt), sapply(names(index_vitals_dt), \(x) clean_up_cols(x,'index_vitals_')))
```

## Merge

```{r merge}
final_X_dt <- demographics_dt %>% full_join(icd_feats_dt, by = "pat_enc_csn_id") %>% 
                                  full_join(labs_dt, by = "pat_enc_csn_id") %>%
                                  full_join(meds_dt, by = "pat_enc_csn_id") %>%
                                  full_join(docvecs_dt, by = "pat_enc_csn_id") %>%
                                  full_join(prior_sxs_dt, by = "pat_enc_csn_id") %>%
                                  full_join(index_sxs_dt, by = "pat_enc_csn_id") %>%
                                  full_join(utilization_dt, by = "pat_enc_csn_id") %>%
                                  full_join(prior_vitals_dt, by = "pat_enc_csn_id") %>%
                                  full_join(index_vitals_dt, by = "pat_enc_csn_id")
```

## Check for Missingness

```{r missingness}
complete.cases(final_X_dt) |> table()
```

## Standardize

Use the transformation dictionary in the `resources/` folder.

```{r standardize}
transformations_dt <- fread('resources/transformation_dictionary.csv')
feature_names <- names(final_X_dt)
feature_names <- feature_names[!feature_names == 'pat_enc_csn_id']
continuous_feature_names <- grep('_vitals_|pat_age|^docvec|^lab_', feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)

for (fname in continuous_feature_names) {
  val_mean <- transformations_dt[continuous_feature_names == fname]$val_mean
  val_sd <- transformations_dt[continuous_feature_names == fname]$val_sd
  if (val_sd > 0) { #this is a double check, shouldn't be any like this
    set(final_X_dt, j = fname, value = (final_X_dt[[fname]] - val_mean) / val_sd)
  } else {
    set(final_X_dt, j = fname, value = final_X_dt[[fname]] ) #if non-zero variance, just leave as is
  }
}
```

## Save

```{r save}
final_X_dt[, pat_enc_csn_id := NULL]
fwrite(final_X_dt, paste0(DATA_DIR, "final_X_dt.csv"))
```
